name: Chijoku Yuugi
source:
In a dimly-lit room there's a lonely nude girl. She is sitting on the floor with her hands tied behind her back. Her background and fate depends on choices.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
昏暗的房間裡坐著一個孤獨的裸體女孩。她雙手被綁在身後，坐在地板上。她的背景與命運，會根據玩家的選擇而改變。
